figurative_meaning_en: An expression of contempt and disdain, implying disowning association
similar_in_english: I'm washing my hands of it
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওদের কাজে আমি জড়াব না, রাম বল।
এসব লোকের সাথে মিশব না, রাম বলে আমি দূরে থাকব।
example_sentences_in_english: I won't get involved in their mess, Ram says.
I won't mix with such people, Ram himself stays away.
history: References Lord Rama from the Ramayana, used to invoke divine disavowal in everyday Bengali speech
note: Synonymous with 'রামচন্দ্র' for emphasizing separation from unworthy associations
